statistics_contract.filtering: none; all observations retained, including outliers
statistics_contract.delta: upstream minus whole; positive means whole reduces the measured endpoint
statistics_contract.reduction: 100 * sum(upstream - whole) / sum(upstream); not the mean of per-pair percentages
statistics_contract.percentiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over unfiltered observations
statistics_contract.pairing: same round, default capacity and repeat in distinct sequential fresh processes
statistics_contract.independence: repeats are nested within process blocks; 80 pairs are not 80 independent process trials
statistics_contract.output_repeatability: pre/post hashes are diagnostic; correctness uses the FP32 tolerance checks

timing_boundaries.wall_us: Pinned preparation, required transfers, native producer, attention replay and final join.
timing_boundaries.preparation_enqueue_us: Host fill/enqueue interval, not completed H2D duration.
timing_boundaries.queue_span_us: Queue span includes submission gaps and dependency waits, not pure attention task time.
timing_boundaries.submit_join_cpu_us: Host submission overlaps device work and must not be added to queue time.

limitation: AB/BA blocks reduce order imbalance but cannot eliminate between-process drift. This bounded attention-chain comparison does not establish absolute causal attribution, full dynamic-trace performance or full-model/end-to-end speedup. Any difference concerns the combined complete-row assignment and FD removal, not isolated FD merge time.
